title: Mixed Event — Tied By Painful Hope — Episode1 An Offer For a New Song?

meta.Episode: Episode1 — An Offer For a New Song?
meta.Event Outline: With their new outfits completed, MORE MORE JUMP! next gets someone to help create an original song for their next show. The composer gets to work, but then faces some troubles...

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
97, 98, 99, 100...
Okay, that's enough sit-ups.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm done working out for today, so I think I'll take a bath now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hm?
A message?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it's from Mai...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
<Evening, Haruka!
How have you been?>

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
<I'll be performing in a new show.
I hope you get a chance to drop in for a look! It's scheduled for...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's performing at the Miyamasuzaka South Hall... That means I could stop by after practice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<I hope practice is going well.
I should be able to make that showing, so break a leg.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm glad Mai's doing so well for herself...)

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Why?! Why can't I sing anymore?! It's not fair!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
I worked so hard.
I never gave up, and now this happens?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mai...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Haruka... You're a liar!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But now...)

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: <Thanks, Haruka! I'll do my best!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good for you, Mai...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This means I need to keep trying my best too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I caused her, ASRUN and our agency so much trouble that time... And above all else, I ended up causing trouble for all of our fans...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But now, I'm back to being an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I have to keep trying and keep spreading hope to my fans and the fans of MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, before I take a bath, I should go over what we'll be doing for tomorrow's stream...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll finally be unveiling the stage outfits our fans made for us, but we start by...
song00004_off_f
song00004_off_f
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, let's start on the count of three.
Are you ready, viewers?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Yeah!>
<New stage outfits!>
<I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I take it we're all ready as well?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes!
Ready whenever.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've been looking forward to seeing how the outfits you designed turned out, Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is a pretty big moment♪
Let's start counting, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay.
One, two... Three!
se_event_painful_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! They're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<They're adorable!>
<Totally divine!>
<These look awesome!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Look! Look!
The skirt on mine's as fluffy as a bunch of feathers!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You're right...!
These turned out so much better than what I initially drew.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we're gonna look amazing on stage with these!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Definitely. Not only that, it's clear that each outfit's been painstakingly made with great care.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all so much for putting together such wonderful outfits for us...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We promise to use these to keep trying our best and spreading as much hope as possible.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Woohoo! Sooo worth the effort!>
<^^^You did an awesome job!>
<They look professionally made!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
“Professional” might even be an understatement!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've sent our dressmakers out there a little something as a token of our appreciation! We hope you like what we got you all!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Thanks! I'm looking forward to it!>
<We're so glad that you like them so much!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I was pretty worried about asking our fans to help us like this...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But it feels like we're heading in the right direction thanks to them.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (All their comments, the way they helped us put on our event, and now, these stage outfits...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(They've given us so much already.
We have to respond by doing everything we can for them...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Once this stream's over, we can start thinking about our next...)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I wanna hear you girls sing a new song while wearing these outfits!!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Yeah! Everyone would go nuts if you sang a new song!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I wanna see you sing a new song in person!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They want us to sing a new song during our next show...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (A new song...)

This stream was really good too...
Their new outfits looked so cute... Haruka, the others and everyone who made them sounded so happy too...
That reminds me of how they had fans help put on an event in real life just the other day.
I wish I could help them out somehow...
What could I do for them...?
bgm_area00002
bgm_area00002
A few days later
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Whoa...! Those look adorable!
They all look so well made too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you should have no trouble dancing in these since they made them using a slightly elastic fabric, and this tulle's so pretty.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They must've put so much care into making these. It's clear just based on the attention to detail.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I almost cried after I saw how amazing these were...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
I really couldn't be happier...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It was my first time designing anything, so I was worried about how these would turn out after they started taking shape.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But the dressmakers were nice enough to give me all these suggestions and ideas to make everything look better...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And thanks to them, these turned out so much better than what I originally designed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wouldn't have been able to make these on my own, so I feel the utmost appreciation for our fans.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Me too.
And we'll need to do our best to make it worth the effort for them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, so next... We're doing a show, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds amazing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Your fans might not know what to do with themselves when they see you perform in these.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of which, one person wrote a comment that said, “I wanna see you sing a new song in person!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (A new song...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, it'd be great if we could get something ready in time for our next show...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, if we can that is...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right...! I completely forgot...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Until now, we've only been singing songs that were born in SEKAI or covers of existing ones...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. We're gonna have to ask someone to write something for us if we want to release a new song as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It'd be nice if we could write one ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Then, wanna try writing one...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: FYI, none of us have any experience with that. Do you just know how long it takes to put an actual song together?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If only we could write our own songs like Shii and her band...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Learning from people with songwriting experience, like Hoshino and her band, could make a difference, but I don't want to get in their way either.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which probably means asking someone to write one for us is our most realistic option.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. If that's the case, it's gonna take a good while to get the ball rolling since we'd have a lot to discuss beforehand.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, chin up!
Yes, I said that it won't be easy, but I didn't say that it's gonna be impossible!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Airi and I feel the same way about wanting to get a new song ready for our next show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But this will be our first time asking someone to do this for us, so I'll try doing some research on my end.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In the meantime, why don't we try coming up with some ideas regarding what kind of song we want to have written?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'll try asking around too.
Let's do everything we can for our fans' sake.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but we need to do this right, so let's take it one step at a time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
I... I actually sent that email...!
What if they're really bothered by it...? But...
I want to be able to help them out somehow...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This order form template should work...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I know how much this could potentially cost now, so all that's left is for us to come up with a theme for our song.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But the question is who to ask...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Ideally, we can find someone who understands who we are as a group...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hm? An email? At this time...?
And it's addressed to MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?
